title: Vitou language - Wikipedia
text: Vitou is a Papuan language of Indonesia used mainly by older adults. It is spoken in Takar village, Sarmi Regency, and is one of two languages known as "Manirem", the other being Betaf.Tor–Kwerba languages (Foja Range).

title: Tor–Kwerba–Nimboran languages - Wikipedia
text: The Tor–Kwerba languages are an independent family of Papuan languages proposed in 2005 by Malcolm Ross.
